name: binder
description: Total binder (cement + SCM) per kg of mortar; mix design binder:sand:water = 1:2.818:0.50 (ASTM C109-type mortar)

name: sand
description: Sand per kg mortar

name: water
description: Mixing water per kg mortar (w/b = 0.50)

name: repl
description: Mass fraction of binder replaced by SCM (RCF on uncarbonated basis; fly ash). Strength verified for lab-paste RCF only.

name: repl_fa
description: Fly-ash replacement level in the reference mortars (held constant when the BioCarb replacement level is varied)

name: cao_field
description: CaO content of field recycled concrete fines. Literature range 11-46 wt%: Korean survey of 20 recycling plants 15-30% (road-aggregate plants 28-31%); RWCP China 11.4%; Egypt RCP 20.5%; paste-rich fines 45-46%
source: Lee et al. 2025 Recycling 10:17; Sci Rep 2024 PMC11547463; J Eng Appl Sci 2026 s44147-026-00899; Sci Rep 2026 s41598-026-46343; Sustainability 2025 17:1506

name: cao_lab
description: CaO of laboratory hydrated OPC paste used in experiments (XRF)

name: CE
description: Total carbonate fraction of CaO after 60 min with TA as measured by TGA (Fig. 1a); includes pre-existing carbonate ce0. Net (new) conversion = CE - ce0 (Eq. S1)

name: ce0_lab
description: Pre-existing carbonate fraction of total CaO in the uncarbonated laboratory paste (CE at t = 0 in Fig. 1a, 16-17 %)

name: ce0_field
description: Pre-existing carbonate fraction of total CaO in field RCF; assumed equal to the lab paste in the base case. Demolition fines are often more carbonated (weathering), so the range extends to 0.40
source: assumption; range from literature on aged concrete fines

name: co2_uptake_lab_measured
description: Measured total carbonate CO2 in the carbonated laboratory product (TGA, = CE x theoretical); reported unchanged as raw data. New CO2 fixed during carbonation = (CE - ce0_lab) x 0.454 = 0.288 kg/kg

name: util
description: CO2 utilization in carbonation column; (1-util) vented as direct emission

name: co2_per_kwh_capture
description: CO2 captured per kWh net electricity, NETL SubPC plant with capture (US-IL); sets electricity co-product per kg CO2 supplied

name: ta_dose
description: Tannic acid dosed to soaking water: 6.6 g TA per 330 g RCF

name: ta_retained
description: Fraction of TA leaving with settled slurry (= fraction of process water retained, 550/1650 g); assumes TA remains dissolved, not adsorbed

name: ls
description: Liquid-to-solid ratio for process-water accounting (v19 text; user: keep, to be updated; SI_1 protocol implies 5.0)

name: water_retained_frac
description: Fraction of process water leaving with settled slurry; remainder recycled (not charged)

name: grind_e
description: Fine grinding of RCF to <75 um; mean of 46 cement ball-mill specifications

name: crush_diesel
description: Mobile jaw crusher diesel; mean of 7 units (2.19 gal/h at 86 t/h)

name: rcf_yield
description: Fines yield from crushing demolition concrete

name: crush_alloc
description: Share of crushing burden allocated to RCF (1.0 = all, conservative; 0.2 = mass allocation)

name: stir_e
description: Agitation: 0.75 kW for 2 h per 433 kg slurry batch (65.5 kg RCF)

name: blower_dp
description: Column gas-side pressure drop (~3 m liquid head)

name: blower_eta
description: Blower efficiency

name: dry_MJ_per_kg_water
description: Electric spray dryer specific energy (240 kW e-heater, 200 kg/h)

name: cake_moisture
description: Residual moisture of dewatered slurry before drying

name: mix_e
description: Mortar mixer electricity (0.56 kW, 10 min per 183.8 kg batch)

name: fa_handling_e
description: Fly ash classification/handling electricity (ash itself burden-free under cut-off)

name: il_clinker
description: Type IL clinker fraction (PCA 2021 EPD: average 10.8% limestone)

name: il_limestone
description: Type IL interground limestone

name: il_gypsum
description: Gypsum in Type IL

name: il_grind_e
description: Finish grinding for IL (1.1 x ball-mill mean)

name: lc3_clay
description: LC3-50 calcined clay

name: lc3_limestone
description: LC3-50 limestone

name: lc3_gypsum
description: LC3-50 gypsum

name: lc3_grind_e
description: LC3 grinding

name: ta_solution_fraction
description: TA content of extraction product (v19 basis: 1 kg final TA solution)

name: ta_methanol_makeup
description: Net methanol make-up (1.00 in; 0.66 + 0.27 recovered and recycled)

name: ta_bark
description: Hardwood bark chips feedstock

name: ta_water
description: Process water for methanol solution

name: ta_methanol_emission
description: Methanol emitted to water (reported as flow; no factor)
